acceptance_signals: A separate human task take-up captures one immutable baseline before repair writes; all pre-existing v3 and user-owned paths remain byte-identical unless explicitly included.
The sorted durable manifest contains exactly the 187 independently derived current distribution paths, including the task-start baseline module exactly once and no guessed or unrelated input.
The manifest path count, canonical path digest, and canonical content digest exactly match fresh independent derivation.
The fixed artifact replay controller binds the same refreshed count, path identity, and content identity without changing request shape, authority, retry, build, cleanup, or privacy behavior.
Focused manifest and controller tests cover the refreshed success identity and retain strict mismatch failure behavior.
Historical records, demonstrations, tasks, and evidence keep their original 186-path facts and are not rewritten as current observations.
Current status and the new dated log distinguish the repair from v3 and do not claim a build, installed artifact, replay, or consumer result.
The full supported test suite, task governance, repository governance, captured scope, task JSON, manifest check, and git diff check pass.
No artifact build, dependency installation, network request, external Agent or model session, synthetic repository, Git operation, publication, release, deployment, or external write occurs.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-e24721b244fe4c648b5180f2c84c0e93 and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Restore the deterministic current distribution-input contract after the task-start baseline module became a package input. Add only that derived path to the durable sorted manifest, refresh its canonical path and content identities, update the fixed artifact replay controller to bind the same 187-path identities, and adjust focused controller expectations. Preserve all historical 186-path evidence and the completed v3 first-deviation record. Validate the manifest, controller failure boundaries, complete repository suite, governance, and captured scope without building an artifact or starting another journey.

items: A wrong manifest path or digest could make future artifact checks accept an incomplete or inconsistent input set.
Updating only the manifest would leave the fixed controller stale; both current owners must move together.
Broad historical 186 references are prior observations and must not be mechanically replaced.
The current worktree contains the completed uncommitted v3 slice and unrelated user files that must remain preserved.
A passing static repair does not prove wheel build, installed behavior, automatic journey success, adoption, reliability, or business benefit.
Reviewed assumption: The baseline module is intended for distribution because it is a regular Python file under the configured package root.
Reviewed assumption: The current manifest derivation algorithm remains the architecture owner for input selection.
Reviewed assumption: The fixed artifact controller is the only live runtime consumer with hard-coded manifest identities.
Reviewed assumption: Historical 186-path records are immutable evidence rather than current identity declarations.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the repaired 187-path artifact will build successfully.
Reviewed unknown: Whether another automatic journey will pass the artifact gate.
Reviewed unknown: Cross-platform installed behavior and consumer benefit remain unknown.
